title: Both searches find the same three continuations.
summary: Under equal 128-transition ceilings, retained programs and a width-two beam find the same three checkpoint witnesses among 16 roots. No gains, losses or censoring. Independent scalar replay checks all 1,502 queried states.
boundary: These are checkpoint continuations from exposed roots, not full route completions. Two prior progress exclusions and eleven unresolved misses remain distinct. Integrated qualification stays 3/4, source comparison closed, and actual-history intervention unestablished.
next: Test checkpoint-aware prefix selection: original records show a generated valid frame-16 path discarded in favor of frame 13. Preserve the existing search and total budgets; test all four cases and count lost successes.
